title: Gateshead Rosh Yeshiva Warns
body: Rav Avrohom Gurwicz, a senior rosh yeshiva, issued a sharply worded letter instructing talmidim not to attend Chabad farbrengens, sparking discussion in the yeshiva world.

title: Knesset Opposes Draft Law Clause
body: Knesset Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee chair MK Boaz Bismuth convenes sessions this week, amidst opposition to a key clause in the IDF Draft Bill from Knesset legal advisors, complicating efforts to advance Israel's long-delayed draft law regulating yeshiva students.

title: Rav Yitzchok Dovid Gurwicz
body: Rav Yitzchok Dovid Gurwicz z”l, 90, passed away. Born in England, he was the eldest son of Rav Aryeh Leib Gurwicz zt”l, rosh yeshiva of Yeshivas Bais Yosef in Gateshead.

title: Cash Gifts for Draft Evaders
body: Three yungeleit honored in Yerushalayim for resisting Israeli military draft, receive 1,000 shekels per day in custody.

title: Chareidi Society Report Released
body: The Israel Democracy Institute published its 2025 Statistical Yearbook of Chareidi Society, edited by Dr. Gilad Malach and Dr. Lee Cahaner. The report shows growth in yeshivos, but stagnation in employment and a complex economic picture for the Chareidi community.
